title: Uncertainties impacting travel demand can't derail us, says Air India chief
description: NEW DELHI, Oct 29: There are many uncertainties impacting overall travel demand, but those cannot “derail us”, Air India chief Campbell Wilson said on Wednesday. The Tata Group-owned airline is estimated to incur a loss of Rs 4,000 crore due to the Pakistan airspace closure, he said and mentioned various uncertainties that are impacting travel demand globally. “I think the operative word in 2025 is uncertainty. title: Indo-Afghan Strategic Renewal
description: Prof. D. Mukherjee* The Taliban’s return to power in August 2021, after the U.S. withdrawal under the Doha Accord, transformed South Asia’s strategic and emotional landscape. For Mother India, this demanded careful recalibration of Afghan policy, balancing security with historic ties. India–Afghanistan relations transcend politics, rooted in civilizational continuity and cultural affinity, exemplified by Tagore’s Kabuliwala. Yet, Pakistan’s interventions since 1947 have exploited Afghan territory to harm India through terror and subversion. The Taliban’s resurgence brings both risk and opportunity. […]

title: Uncertainties impacting travel demand can't derail us, says Air India chief
description: Air India faces significant challenges. The airline anticipates a Rs 4,000 crore loss from Pakistan's airspace closure. Global trade, peace, and politics create uncertainty. Unprecedented events like a plane crash and regional conflicts impact operations. Despite these headwinds, Air India's chief asserts the airline will not be derailed. The focus remains on becoming a world-class global airline.

title: From India to Pakistan and the global diaspora, South Asian sounds make an impact worldwide
description: Music from South Asia is captivating global audiences. Artists like Arooj Aftab and Diljit Dosanjh are achieving international recognition. New labels are emerging to promote these sounds. Technology and evolving tastes are driving this trend. Younger generations are embracing these diverse musical influences. This marks a significant moment for South Asian artists on the world stage.
